text:
Alicia G: quick heads up — new hire Rohan (international) accepted offer. He's on OPT and will apply for STEM extension. Starting window is May 12. Need to confirm docs we need before day 1 :wave:
Dmitri K: thanks. main things: copy of EAD (front/back), passport, most recent I-94, signed I-983 training plan, offer letter. Also need start/end dates for the I-983.
Maria P: also schedule I-9 verification within 3 days of start. For remote hires we use authorized agent process — do we have Rohan's local address for agent?
Alicia G: he's remote in CA. I have his address. Do we need anything else for STEM filing from our side?
Dmitri K: employer info for STEM is mostly standard: EIN, employer name/address, official signatory. People Ops provides the attestation and retains copies. USCIS link for reference: https://www.uscis.gov/opt-stem
Rohan P: thanks all — I'm already on OPT; EAD valid through 2026-08-03. I'll DM the scanned docs tonight. Quick Q: can I start before STEM is filed?
Maria P: you can start as soon as your current EAD is valid. STEM filing is for extending after that EAD expires. We'll file within the 90-day window before expiry. :white_check_mark:
Alicia G: timeline note: aim to file STEM 60–90 days before expiry so we have cushion. Please send docs by EOD Friday if possible.
Dmitri K: checklist (for uploading to /hr-onboarding):
```
- EAD front/back (PDF)
- Passport photo page
- Most recent I-94 (PDF)
- Signed I-983 (PDF)
- Offer letter (signed)
- CA address for I-9 agent
```
hr-bot: Reminder: background check must be completed prior to activating payroll. Link: https://redwood.example.com/backgrounds
Rohan P: will upload tonight. one more Q — do I sign the I-983 before or after start date?
Dmitri K: sign and date the I-983 with the employer section filled. The employer signatory can sign the company section after you submit; just ensure dates line up. We'll coordinate signature with you.
Maria P: FYI payroll setup: put tentative payroll start 05/12 and mark "pending I-9 verification". Once agent completes Section 2 we'll flip to active.
Alicia G: perfect. thanks team — tagging follow-ups: @Dmitri K to prepare employer attestation docs, @Maria P to book local I-9 agent slots for May 12–14. Rohan, DM Alicia when docs uploaded. :thumbsup:
__nofield_note: All values are strings or list of strings as required.
